title: MV About using plugins from other games...

posts.author: Fr4ncioh
posts.body:
Hello!
I’m working on a personal game that I plan to sell on Steam and other platforms (maybe even consoles if I get lucky). I came across some plugins while decrypting Omori and a few other paid RPG Maker MV games that I legally own, and I’d like to ask if it’s okay to use them in my game, as long as I give proper credit.
Many of these plugins don’t seem to have a license, and I haven’t been able to find information about most of them online. I don’t know if they were made specifically for the games they appear in, and I don’t want to take anything without permission or run into any legal issues, so I wanted to ask before using anything.
Cheers.

posts.author: Zia_
posts.body:
Simple answer is no.
Just because you can't find an official download for any kind of asset or code, doesn't mean it's free to use.
You can try to contact the devs of the games for more info about their plugins and check if they are fine with it.

posts.author: hiddenone
posts.body:
Do not decrypt other RPG Maker games or ask for help with ripped resources, as it is against
forum rules
. You won't get permission to use plugins you rip from other games, so don't even bother.
